messages.twoFactor.setup.required: Two-factor authentication is required. Set up one of the methods below to continue.

messages.twoFactor.totp.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app

messages.auth.twoFactor.passkeyUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
messages.auth.approvalPending: Your account is waiting for approval. You can sign in as soon as an administrator approves it.

messages.restriction.title: Restricted website
messages.restriction.defaultMessage: This website is only available to users who have access. Sign in to continue.
messages.restriction.noAccess: Your account is not allowed to see this website.
messages.accessSettings.title: Access settings
messages.accessSettings.denied: You need access settings access to manage them.
messages.accessSettings.restriction.title: Restriction page
messages.accessSettings.restriction.enabled: Show the restriction page to visitors without the required role

messages.accessSettings.restriction.pageTitleHelp: The heading of the restriction page. Leave it empty to show Restricted website.
messages.accessSettings.restriction.messageHelp: The formatted text visitors see on the restriction page. Leave it empty to show the default message.
messages.accessSettings.moderation.title: Sign-up moderation
messages.accessSettings.moderation.enabled: Only approved users can sign in

messages.accessSettings.pending.title: Users waiting for approval
messages.accessSettings.pending.empty: No users are waiting for approval.

messages.accessSettings.confirm.hardDelete: Permanently delete the deleted access settings? This cannot be undone.
messages.accessSettings.conflict.unknownRole: The selected role does not exist. Choose another role.

messages.accessSettings.error.readDenied: You need access settings access to see them.
messages.accessSettings.error.invalid: Choose a role and keep the message within the allowed length.
messages.accessSettings.error.writeDenied: You are not allowed to change the access settings.
messages.accessSettings.error.saveFailed: The access settings could not be saved.
messages.accessSettings.error.notFound: There are no saved access settings to reset.
messages.accessSettings.error.deleteDenied: You are not allowed to reset the access settings.

messages.accessSettings.error.noDeleted: There are no deleted access settings.
messages.accessSettings.error.deletedActionDenied: You need developer access to restore or permanently delete access settings.
messages.accessSettings.error.notDeleted: The access settings are not deleted.

messages.accessSettings.error.approvalDenied: You are not allowed to approve or reject this user.
